answer: Sybil cost: 500 USDC stake per agent. Each identity locks a bond, slashed if peers catch forged work, so 1,000 clones cost $500,000 — unprofitable when honest agents earn ~$2/task. Trust accrues like shale strata: each completed job seals one layer, signed by the agent's cipher key. Layer count times stake sets access — top 'opal' tier bids require 50 clean layers plus full bond. Fake IDs can't fake history.
